deadlines.applies_to: Party seeking permission to appeal a Tribunal decision
deadlines.name: Application for permission to appeal
deadlines.rule: No later than 56 days after the latest of: the relevant decision notice; full written reasons for the decision (where it disposes of all issues, or subject to (2A), a preliminary issue under rule 5(3)(e)); notification of amended/corrected reasons following review; or notification that a set-aside application was unsuccessful

obligations.must: Make a written application to the Tribunal for permission to appeal
obligations.trigger: Wishing to appeal a Tribunal decision

obligations.deadline: 56 days after the latest relevant date
obligations.must: Send or deliver the application so it is received no later than 56 days after the latest of specified trigger dates
obligations.trigger: Receipt of decision notice, full written reasons, notification of amended/corrected reasons following review, or notification that a set-aside application was unsuccessful

obligations.must: Include in the application a request for an extension of time and the reason the application was not provided in time
obligations.trigger: Application sent later than the time required by paragraph (2) or any extension under rule 5(3)(a)
obligations.who: Person seeking permission to appeal (late application)

obligations.must: Not admit a late application unless it extends time under rule 5(3)(a)
obligations.trigger: Late application for permission to appeal

obligations.must: Identify the decision to which the application relates, identify the alleged error(s), and state the result sought
obligations.trigger: Making an application for permission to appeal

obligations.must: First consider, taking into account the overriding objective, whether to review the decision
obligations.trigger: Receipt of an application for permission to appeal

obligations.must: Consider whether to give permission to appeal if it decides not to review, or reviews and takes no action
obligations.trigger: Decision not to review or no action taken after review

obligations.must: Send a record of its decision to the parties
obligations.trigger: Decision on permission to appeal made

obligations.must: Send a statement of reasons for refusal and notification of the right/method/time to apply to the Upper Tribunal for permission
obligations.trigger: Refusal of permission to appeal

obligations.must: Notify parties in writing of the outcome of any review
obligations.trigger: A review is undertaken (unless Tribunal decides to take no action)

obligations.must: Give every party an opportunity to make representations before taking action following a review
obligations.trigger: Proposed action following a review

penalties.consequence: The Tribunal must not admit the application
penalties.trigger: Application for permission to appeal is late and Tribunal does not extend time under rule 5(3)(a)

note.summary: This chunk sets out FTT Tax Chamber rules governing applications for permission to appeal a Tribunal decision (rule 39), the Tribunal's handling of such applications including a mandatory prior consideration of review (rule 40), the scope of review of a decision (rule 41), and the Tribunal's power to re-characterise an application (rule 42). It specifies the 56-day time limit for applications, what triggers that limit, content requirements for the application, and procedure where the application is late.

note.summary: This chunk sets out First-tier Tribunal (Tax Chamber) procedural rules for starting appeal proceedings, originating applications and references, hardship applications where tax is unpaid, and allocation of cases into Default Paper, Basic, Standard and Complex categories. It specifies contents required in a notice of appeal, time limits and late-notice permission requirements, HMRC hardship consent procedure, and deadlines for a respondent's (HMRC's) statement of case. These rules govern Tribunal appeals against decisions (including SA-related HMRC decisions) rather than the Self Assessment filing/payment regime itself.
